items.title: Bun creator Jarred Sumner rewrote a million lines of code with Claude in 11 days, and every line was checked by two agen
items.summary:
Bun creator Jarred Sumner rewrote a million lines of code with Claude in 11 days, and every line was checked by two agents that didn't write it

I broke down his setup, added one more layer of control on top, and packed it all into one prompt for Opus 5.5

→ one agent writes the code
→ two others, each in its own context, see only the diff and have to prove it doesn't work
→ a fourth agent checks the checkers, drops false alarms and looks for what they missed
→ whoever writes doesn't review, and whoever reviews doesn't write
→ reviewers reject stubs, weakened tests and "explanatory" comments instead of real fixes
→ if a bug repeats, the agent doesn't patch the code, it adds a rule so it never happens again
→ it's done only when every test passes and none are skipped

Throw it at Opus 5.5 with the task you're scared to hand to an agent, and see how many bugs it catches on its own.

The full prompt is in the comments.

How to tune it for your own work is in the article below. Save it before it gets lost ↓

items.title: It's pretty wild that people still run Claude Code bare when these 7 repos have over 1,000,000 GitHub stars combined
items.summary:
It's pretty wild that people still run Claude Code bare when these 7 repos have over 1,000,000 GitHub stars combined

1. Load 4 coding rules drawn from Karpathy's post (230K): /plugin marketplace add forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills

2. Make Claude write the least code that works (186K): /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail

3. Add 7 design skills with 192 palettes (146K): /plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill

4. Run Garry Tan's own setup, /office-hours to /ship (141K): paste the install line from https://t.co/3D3dMVt5hg, needs Bun

5. Cut Claude's replies to caveman length, code stays exact (118K): /plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman

6. Add Addy Osmani's 25 skills, spec to ship (114K): /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills

7. Shrink the shell output Claude reads (86K): brew install rtk, then rtk init -g

After each marketplace add, run /plugin and install it from the Discover tab

gstack adds a Stop hook and Codex reviews of your diffs, rtk patches settings.json: read both READMEs first

items.title: Bun Mee brings a Vietnamese classic to NYC for National Sandwich Day | amNewYork
items.summary:
In a world dominated by ham and cheese, turkey clubs, and traditional deli sandwiches, bánh mì offers something completely different. It’s a uniquely Asian sandwich with a flavor profile and personality all its own, yet it’s still a relatively untapped niche within America’s enormous sandwich category. The sandwich combines French and Vietnamese culinary influences, layering crusty bread with savory proteins, sauces, pickled vegetables, fresh herbs, and heat. [...] “My vision when I started Bun Mee was to make bánh mì as common as burgers and tacos,” Tran said. “I believe it has all the ingredients to become one of America’s great everyday sandwiches.” [...] By Bridgette Leahy

… Comments

Posted on

food spread from Bun Mee

Bun Mee is celebrating a Vietnamese classic to National Sandwich Day.

Photo courtesy of Bun Mee

New York knows a thing or two about sandwiches. From famous deli classics to classic Italian heroes, nearly every neighborhood has a go-to spot. Still, on National Sandwich Day, Bun Mee debuted as another classic sandwich spot in the lineup: the Vietnamese bánh mì.
